## What changes and why

Describe the concrete behavior in plain language. Name the milestone and baseline.

## Acceptance and validation

- Acceptance criteria and named tests / real-input evidence:
- Five-field / six-pitch results and unresolved scope, where applicable:
- Source, error controls, measured accuracy and runtime:
- Mutations applied, observed red tests, and confirmation they were reverted:
- `make test`, `make check`, and packaging smoke results:

For documentation-only work, give relevant checks instead of invented numerical evidence.

## Limits and decisions

State deviations/ADRs, blockers, and anything the next milestone needs. Say explicitly
if the proposed algorithm looks unlikely to meet its accuracy/runtime target.
